shortlist.title: Finish Your Payment Emails Cannot Be Disabled and Are NOT Automatic Invoice Reminders
shortlist.text: I do not use Automatic Invoice Reminders. They are disabled on my account. Despite this, QuickBooks sends my customers a Finish your payment email approximately 48 hours after I send their invoice, even though our invoices have Net 30 payment terms. Disabling Online automatically follows up does not stop it. The only method I have found that stops these emails is changing Online Delivery to Plain Text Only, which removes invoice tracking. Where is the setting to independently disable it?

draft.painPoint: QuickBooks emails their Net 30 customers a Finish your payment nudge two days after an invoice goes out, with reminders already off and no setting to stop it.
draft.reply: What you describe matches what several people in this thread see: the Automatic invoice reminders setting under Account and settings, Sales, Reminders is a separate thing from this email, so turning it off does not touch it. I can't point you to a switch for the Finish your payment email, and I don't think one exists right now. Until Intuit changes that, the only lever people report is Plain Text Only delivery, and you lose open tracking with it. For Net 30 customers with their own AP runs, it may be worth a short heads-up line in your invoice message saying payment follows your agreed terms and any nudge email from QuickBooks can be ignored. And since support keeps sending you to the wrong setting, ask for the case to be escalated to the product team and quote the 48 hour timing from your mock customer test.

skipped.why: no invoice or payment pain in the text
